title: newtype, Semigroup & Monoid
hints: README 'New syntax': each instance body is one equation; `mconcat`, `foldr1`, `dropWhile`/`dropWhileEnd` do the heavy lifting.

Score: unwrap both, add, wrap again; mempty is Score 0. MaxScore: wrap the larger. totalScore: mconcat (no argument needed). best: Nothing for [], else combine everything with <> (foldr1). mkName: strip spaces from both ends; empty → Nothing, else Just (Name …).
Other data: `Longest a <> Longest b = if length b > length a then Longest b else Longest a` · `foldr1 (<>) ["a", "b"]` → "ab" · `dropWhileEnd (== '!') "hi!!"` → "hi".
`Score a <> Score b = Score (a + b)` · `mempty = Score 0` · `best scores = Just (foldr1 (<>) scores)` after `best [] = Nothing` · trimmed = `dropWhileEnd isSpace (dropWhile isSpace raw)`.
